title: ConfirmationProof
description: The proof that a person confirmed one exact action: what was confirmed (the identity of the action, for a trajectory its fingerprint), for which robot or subject, who confirmed it, when, until when it counts and a keyed signature over all of that. kind says where the confirmation came from: approval (the approval of a proposal) or voice (a signed result of the voice interface). approval_id, when present, lets the layer that acts accept the proof only once. The schema is closed; a consumer that acts checks the signature, the subject, the action and the window with the helpers of the clients, never the schema alone.

action_id.description: The identity of the action that was confirmed (for a trajectory, its fingerprint).

subject_id.description: The robot or machine the action is for.

approved_at_ms.description: When the person confirmed, in milliseconds since the epoch.

expires_at_ms.description: Until when the proof counts, in milliseconds since the epoch.

approval_id.description: A random identity of this proof, for accepting it only once.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256, in hexadecimal, over the other fields as the clients build the message.
